b: Peak leaf season seemed like a great time to test out Milwaukee’s battery-powered cordless blowers. We sent a request to Milwaukee, and they obliged with test samples and appropriate battery pairings.
I tested Milwaukee blowers in each handheld size, to help me figure out which would best fit my needs, and to put things into context.
For simplicity and comparison, I focused on how they moved leaves.
The test samples arrived shortly after Stuart connected with Milwaukee.

I was like a kid in a candy shop opening these boxes! I was so excited to get started that I ran across the street to the park next door in my pajamas and slippers to round up some leaves. Nothing like a little neighborhood leaf cleanup in sleepwear.

Stuart’s Note: Oh, she’s 100% serious. We were Facetiming as Lauren opened the boxes, and things quickly escalated from “I need to make sure it works” to “let me see how it works on the front steps,” and then to “WOW I need to see more, NOW.” I won’t ever admit to doing the same.
Milwaukee M12 Compact Blower First Impressions
The Milwaukee M12 Compact Blower was the one I gravitated toward first. Living in an apartment, it made the most sense for my everyday needs.
I found the blower to be quiet, lightweight, and easy to manage without feeling like I was bringing out a huge piece of equipment for a small job.

It has two power settings, which I really liked. The lower setting handled lightweight debris, while the higher setting was strong enough to clear leaves from my steps and sidewalk. It’s a great option for dust, dirt, and lighter cleanup, but it struggled with wet leaves and more stubborn, caked-on dirt.
Stuart’s Note: I’m a fan of the size too! It has the reach for air-sweeping the floor or driveway, and ample power for quick cleaning where a full-size blower might be unwieldy.
Milwaukee M18 Brushless Precision Blower First Impressions
Next up was the Milwaukee M18 Precision Blower, which I was probably most excited to try.
Stuart’s Note: That’s the one Lauren expressed interest in, and I (successfully) convinced her to agree to try the others too. Thank you to Milwaukee for facilitating!
My car gets absolutely covered in leaves this time of year, so having something compact that could quickly clear them away was a big selling point.
This blower was incredibly lightweight, almost like holding a drill, but packed a surprising amount of power.
It was easy to handle and great for getting into tighter spaces.
I also really appreciated the variety of nozzles that came with it, making it more versatile for different cleanup jobs.

Stuart’s Note: Count me in the “I love this tool!” camp. It’s well suited for knocking dust and debris out of crevices, such as cleaning chunks out of woodworking tools and equipment in spots vacuum nozzles cannot easily reach. Wear eye protection!
Milwaukee M18 FUEL Cordless Blower First Impressions
Kit includes FORGE 12Ah battery, Rapid charger
The Milwaukee M18 FUEL Blower ended up being my favorite overall.
It struck the best balance of power and ease of use for the jobs I was tackling.
The blower felt lightweight, had very little vibration, and had enough power to clear my entire sidewalk in just a couple of minutes.

Stuart’s Note: Lauren was actually worried about the weight, given the size of the M18 FORGE 12Ah battery, which is a great choice for extended work sessions. I told her not to worry, it will feel balanced on the tool.
I also found it relatively quiet, which is always a plus when you live around other people.
The battery did drain quicker than I anticipated, but I was able to finish my cleanup before it fully depleted, so I can’t complain too much.
I also had my Landlord, who currently uses an electric blower, give it a whirl. He said this was so much easier to use and that he would buy it in a heartbeat.
Each blower had its place, but testing them side by side made it easier to see where each one shines.
For clearing smaller areas or quick touch-ups, I’d reach for the M12 blower. It’s compact and lightweight, and was well-suited for lighter tasks and where I wanted a little more control.
For cleaning out the car, tight spaces, and more targeted blowing, the M18 Brushless Precision Blower was a pleasant surprise. It was very capable in a nimble package.
And when I wanted to get outside and knock out the leaves on my sidewalk quickly, the M18 FUEL was the one I wanted in my hand. It delivered power without any obvious compromises.
